display_long_description:
This application offers a complete Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) training experience within the Linde Virtual Academy (LVA) framework. Master essential safety procedures that prevent the unexpected release of hazardous energy during equipment maintenance and servicing operations.

The Linde Virtual Academy's LOTO module provides a realistic, immersive environment where trainees can practice identifying various energy sources (electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, chemical, and thermal) within a virtual gas processing facility. This scenario specifically focuses on the mechanical isolation of a gas vessel, teaching users the proper procedures to safely lock out and tag this critical equipment. Users learn to select appropriate lockout devices, properly secure equipment, verify zero energy state, and follow all required documentation steps in a comprehensive workflow.

This training is developed based on Linde standards and industry best practices, ensuring participants learn procedures that align with real-world operations. The LOTO module is fully integrated with the Linde Virtual Academy training platform, allowing seamless progression between different safety and operational training modules. It harmonizes well with other trainings developed by Linde, creating a comprehensive learning journey for professionals in the gas processing industry."
